name: SlugQueen
identity: Legless low olive-brown slug queen, three broad rounded arching body lobes tapering to a small rear rump, ochre oval patches and cream short highlights. Rounded broad short head with gold eyes, circular protruding short snout. One tiny gold crown with dark oval jewel shapes is INTEGRATED ON THE HEAD only. No legs, feelers, wings, shell or separate tail.

source_observations.source_review: Actual original atlas and full source prefab viewed. Normal stern gold eyes and round snout; angry open tooth mouth; dead blank round gold eyes and slack snout.
